headline_item.title_en: TML releases Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights 26.4B-parameter transformer that loops middle layers three times per token for better reasoning with fewer tokens (Thinking Machines Lab)

headline_item.event_summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Inkling 2 Mini, an open-weights model with 26.4B parameters, utilizing a 'looped transformer' architecture that executes middle layers three times per token. This design enhances reasoning capabilities for agentic coding and serial tasks while maintaining a 20GB memory footprint suitable for local deployment on consumer hardware.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】思维机器实验室在AI模型开源社区：发布Inkling 2 Mini模型，具备26.4B总参数、循环层架构及本地化部署能力
【起因与机理】旨在通过架构创新解决推理深度与算力消耗间的矛盾
【关键技术规格】引入循环层机制提升逻辑推理效能。
【各方立场与态度】支持本地设备端离线运行与高并发定制。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] Thinking Machines Lab (AI Open Source Community): Released Inkling 2 Mini with 26.4B parameters, looped architecture, and local deployment optimization
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To balance reasoning depth with computational efficiency
[Key Metrics] 20GB memory footprint for a 26.4B parameter model.
[Key Position & Outlook] Optimized for local deployment and on-device customization.
headline_item.industry_impact_zh: 模型架构从单纯的堆叠参数转向利用循环权重优化算术逻辑效率，这是应对边缘侧高强度推理需求的关键转向。此举通过复用推理深度而非单纯堆叠权重，不仅降低了训练与推理的显存成本，更在可控性与思维链透明度上为agentic AI的商业化落地提供了更低部署门槛的范式。
headline_item.industry_impact_en: The shift from sheer parameter scaling to looped weight execution marks a critical pivot in optimizing logic efficiency for edge-side high-intensity inference. By reusing depth rather than stacking weights, this architecture lowers memory costs and improves chain-of-thought transparency, offering a more accessible paradigm for commercial agentic AI deployment.

headlines.title_zh: AI供应链隐私审计：200万次蜜罐测试揭露数据泄露
headlines.title_en: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
headlines.event_summary_zh: 安全研究员HD Moore通过200万次蜜罐测试发现，AI路由与中介服务存在严重的数据隐私泄露漏洞
headlines.event_summary_en: HD Moore, Chief Research Officer at Dragos, uncovered major security flaws in the AI supply chain by injecting 2 million trackable 'canary' secrets into AI prompts sent via routing services. The investigation found evidence of prompt theft, disregard for zero-data-retention (ZDR) settings, and unauthorized logging of user prompts by intermediaries, posing significant compliance risks.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】HD Moore（Dragos首席研究官）在AI服务路由与中介平台：植入200万个可追踪的伪造敏感凭证进行安全审计，发现严重数据泄露与隐私违规
【起因与机理】验证当前复杂的AI供应链对敏感信息处理的合规性与安全性
【关键数据与实测】利用200万个蜜罐凭证实现供应链审计。
【各方立场与态度】零数据留存政策（ZDR）在执行端全面失效。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] HD Moore (CRO of Dragos): Injected 2 million trackable 'canaries' into prompts to audit security, uncovering widespread data leaks and privacy violations
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To verify the security and compliance of sensitive data handling within the complex AI supply chain
[Key Fact Detail] Supply chain audit using 2 million canary credentials.
[Key Position & Outlook] Widespread failure of Zero Data Retention (ZDR) policy enforcement.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: AI应用通过路由中介连接多层供应商的碎片化生态，已成为企业数据合规的“黑盒”灾难点。当前的供应链缺乏端到端的信任保障，中介平台的无差别日志记录与零数据留存政策的执行失效，表明现行法律监管与商业承诺在复杂的调用链面前显得极其脆弱。
headlines.industry_impact_en: The fragmented ecosystem where AI apps connect through intermediaries to multiple suppliers has become a black-box liability for corporate compliance. The current supply chain lacks end-to-end trust, and the failure of ZDR enforcement and unauthorized logging suggest that existing regulatory frameworks and commercial pledges are highly fragile against complex multi-hop call chains.

headlines.title_zh: OpenAI强化推理层防护，抑制大模型蒸馏攻击
headlines.title_en: OpenAI makes it much harder for attackers to extract how its latest AI models think
headlines.event_summary_zh: OpenAI大幅提升GPT-6.2系列模型安全性，通过多层过滤机制将推理数据泄露攻击成功率降至0.2%以下
headlines.event_summary_en: OpenAI has deployed layered security mechanisms for GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol models, reducing the success rate of black-box inference-extraction attacks from 54% to under 0.2% through targeted training, input/output filtering, and API access restrictions. These measures are designed to neutralize distillation attacks that attempt to reconstruct core reasoning paths, supplemented by the weekly suspension of tens of thousands of illicit accounts.
core_facts_zh: 【核心事件】OpenAI（模型开发者）在企业内部模型安全生产环境：部署针对推理数据的多层防护架构，包括输入/输出过滤、API访问拦截及针对性强化训练
【起因与机理】防止攻击者通过模型蒸馏技术窃取核心推理逻辑，保护模型技术壁垒
【关键数据与实测】技术细节：攻击成功率从54%降至0.2%（先前模型）及0.9%（当前活跃请求）。
【涉及范围与推进】行业动向：包括Anthropic在内的头部厂商正通过大规模封禁账户与协同政策倡议，建立防御阵线。
core_facts_en: [Core Event] OpenAI: Implemented layered defenses including I/O filtering, API blocking, and adversarial training
[Root Cause & Mechanism] To prevent distillation-based theft of internal reasoning logic and protect proprietary model intellectual property
[Key Metrics] Technical metrics: Attack success rate dropped from 54% to 0.2% for prior models, and 22.9% to 0.9% for active requests.
[Industry Impact & Outlook] Industry trend: Leading vendors like Anthropic are scaling up account suspensions and advocating for coordinated policy responses.
headlines.industry_impact_zh: 大模型竞争已进入以‘知识产权保全’为核心的防蒸馏防御战阶段。随着模型推理逻辑的价值攀升，闭源大模型厂商正通过强化API黑盒化与流量合规清洗，从底层逻辑上切断廉价获取高质量蒸馏数据的路径，这将迫使后续开源模型生态面临更严苛的训练数据合规审查压力。
headlines.industry_impact_en: Competition in the large model sector has shifted toward intellectual property preservation via anti-distillation defense. As reasoning logic becomes a primary value driver, proprietary model vendors are increasingly 'black-boxing' APIs and cleansing traffic to block cost-effective distillation, likely forcing the open-source community to face significantly higher scrutiny regarding training data provenance.

titans.name: Yann LeCun
titans.role_zh: Meta 首席AI科学家 / 深度学习三巨头 / 图灵奖得主
titans.event_context_zh:
纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.event_context_en: @int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify a
titans.quote_zh:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun 正则化器只是指定归纳偏差的一种方法。

您的模型架构和您使用的优化过程已经存在归纳偏差：它们比其他函数更喜欢生成某些函数。

正则化器只是强加了另一种偏差。

学习理论告诉你，你必须有归纳偏差，否则你无法通过合理数量的样本或试验学到任何东西（VC理论，没有免费的午餐定理）。

所以，从概念上、理论上、哲学上和实践上来说，正则化器都没有问题。
titans.quote_en:
@int_16h @torchedvision @MuzafferKal_ @mengyer @yingwww_ @choang333 @KuangYilun Regularizers are just a way to specify an inductive bias.

The architecture of your model, and the optimization procedure you use already have inductive biases: they like to produce certain functions more than others.

A regularizer merely imposes another bias.

Learning theory tells you that you have to have an inductive bias, otherwise you can't learn anything with a reasonable number of samples or trials (VC theory, no free lunch theorems).

So, conceptually, theoretically, philosophically, and practically, there is nothing wrong with regularizers.
